# Scoped API keys

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:api-keys` · **Epic:** [#106](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/106) · **Tickets:** 3 (2S 1M)

Adds scoped, expiring API keys for automation against the CP admin API, replacing shared bearer tokens for scripts and CI. Admins create, list and revoke keys in the console and see when each was last used.

## How we build it

- Format `wdn_<8-char id>_<32-byte base64url secret>`; stored as id + SHA-256(secret) (secret has 256 bits of entropy so no slow hash needed) + scopes + owner + created_at + expires_at + last_used_at + revoked_at in `api_keys` table.
- Scopes: policy:read, policy:write, policy:approve, audit:read, agents:read, agents:write, workers:admin, keys:admin; each admin route declares its required scope.
- Middleware in internal/controlplane accepts `Authorization: Bearer wdn_...` on /api/* only; resolves to a principal {type: apikey, id, owner, scopes} used by audit; constant-time compare; last_used_at updated at most once per minute.
- Keys cannot be used for worker routes or /oauth2/token; max expiry 1 year (config `apiKeys.maxTTL`); owner's console role caps the scopes they can grant.

## Done when

A script using a policy:read key can read policy but gets 403 on writes, and a revoked or expired key is rejected immediately.

### 1/3 · W-P2-APIK-01

**Add internal/apikeys generation, hashing and store**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#107](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/107)

Create new package internal/apikeys with Generate(scopes, ttl, owner) returning the plaintext once, Parse for the wdn_ format, Lookup by id + constant-time hash compare, Revoke, and a SQLite store (api_keys table).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Plaintext secret not recoverable from the DB
- [ ] Malformed or wrong-prefix keys fail Parse
- [ ] Expired and revoked keys fail Lookup

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-APIK-02`](api-keys.md#23--w-p2-apik-02) Add API key auth middleware with per-route scopes

### 2/3 · W-P2-APIK-02

**Add API key auth middleware with per-route scopes**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#108](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/108)

Add middleware in internal/controlplane that authenticates Bearer wdn_ keys on /api/* routes, attaches a Principal alongside the P1 session principal, and a `requireScope(scope)` wrapper applied to every admin route (policy, drafts, agents, workers, keys, audit). Throttle last_used_at writes to once per minute per key.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] policy:read key gets 403 on POST /api/policy/drafts
- [ ] wdn_ key rejected on /policy and /oauth2/token
- [ ] Audit entries show actor type apikey and key id

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-APIK-01`](api-keys.md#13--w-p2-apik-01) Add internal/apikeys generation, hashing and store

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-APIK-03`](api-keys.md#33--w-p2-apik-03) Add API keys management UI and API

### 3/3 · W-P2-APIK-03

**Add API keys management UI and API**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#109](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/109)

Add `/api/keys/api` CRUD (create returns plaintext once, list shows prefix id, scopes, expiry, last used) and an API Keys page in internal/dashboard. Granted scopes are capped by the creator's role.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Plaintext shown only in the create response
- [ ] Viewer cannot create a policy:write key
- [ ] Revoke takes effect on the next request

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-APIK-02`](api-keys.md#23--w-p2-apik-02) Add API key auth middleware with per-route scopes
